**Professional Experience**  
At AdVerve Technologies, I focused on stabilizing and scaling their adtech platform. As Senior Site Reliability Engineer, I led the transition from monolithic to microservices architecture, reducing deployment latency by 40% through optimized CI/CD pipelines. I designed chaos engineering experiments that uncovered 12 critical bottlenecks, improving system resilience to 99.95% SLA. Cloud cost optimization efforts slashed monthly AWS expenses by $120k via automated scaling policies and reserved instance strategies.  

Prior to that, as Lead DevOps Engineer at MediaSphere Inc., I spearheaded the migration of their legacy infrastructure to Kubernetes, enabling 3x faster rollouts and 50% reduction in downtime. I implemented load balancing solutions that handled 20M+ requests/day during peak campaigns, ensuring consistent performance across 15+ regional endpoints. Monitoring systems built with Prometheus and Grafana reduced mean time to detect issues by 30%, while custom alerts minimized false positives by 65%.  

In my early career at ClickAd Studio, I automated 80% of manual deployments using Terraform, cutting deployment errors by 70%. I also integrated serverless functions for real-time analytics, improving data processing latency by 25%. These projects established a foundation for scalable, resilient systems that align with enterprise-grade adtech demands.  

**Technical Skills**  
CI/CD pipelines: Engineered and maintained Jenkins-based workflows that reduced deployment cycles from 45 to 15 minutes at AdVerve. Implemented GitOps practices for Kubernetes clusters, ensuring zero-downtime updates across 10+ environments.  
Chaos engineering: Orchestrated production-wide stress tests that identified critical dependencies, leading to 20% improvement in fault tolerance. Automated chaos experiments using Chaos Monkey, reducing manual intervention by 50%.  
Cloud cost optimization: Designed AWS cost models that identified underutilized resources, resulting in $120k annual savings. Automated spot instance scaling for batch processing, cutting compute costs by 35%.  
Kubernetes: Architected a hybrid cluster setup for AdVerve, supporting 500+ microservices with automated self-healing. Reduced pod restarts by 40% through improved liveness/readiness probe configurations.  
Load balancing: Deployed NGINX Plus to manage 20M+ requests/day, achieving 99.9% uptime during high-traffic campaigns. Implemented global load distribution to minimize latency for European and Asian users.  
Monitoring & alerting: Built Prometheus-based dashboards for real-time metrics, reducing MTTR by 30%. Developed custom Grafana panels for cost tracking, enabling proactive budget adjustments.  
Prometheus/Grafana: Centralized metrics collection across 15+ services, providing actionable insights for performance tuning. Automated alert suppression rules to cut noise by 65%.  
Python: Automated infrastructure audits using custom scripts, identifying 150+ inefficiencies in server configurations. Developed API integrations for third-party tools, streamlining deployment workflows.  
Serverless: Built Lambda functions for real-time analytics, reducing compute costs by 25%. Designed DynamoDB sharding strategies to handle 1M+ requests/day without performance degradation.  
Terraform: Standardized infrastructure as code across 10+ environments, ensuring consistency and reducing configuration drift. Mentored junior engineers on best practices, improving team efficiency by 20%.  
AWS: Led multi-year architecture decisions for AdVerve’s cloud strategy, including VPC segmentation and IAM governance. Mentored cross-functional teams on cost management and security best practices.
